question: persistent_memory
comparison: Paired persistent-memory condition versus memory-disabled/empty condition. A frozen prebuilt-memory arm answers a different question from ongoing writeback.
keep_fixed: Task backbone, orchestration, tools, starting policy and base artifacts, feedback access and initial cases. Keep the patient/case sequence paired or record the ordering difference.
separation: Write back only after the current case. State which labels become available and when. Distinguish an online adaptation stream from an untouched final test.
cost: Count retrieval, distillation, verification, specialist calls and memory maintenance in both arms; report missing measurements.
interpretation: Estimate the contribution of the retained memory under this procedure. This comparison alone does not test a better updater.

question: changed_generator_or_recipe
comparison: Changed generator/operator/skill/recipe versus the corresponding frozen version, followed by matched learner training and independent downstream evaluation.
keep_fixed: Shared learner start, task model, training protocol, data access, selection rule and downstream evaluator. State whether accepted-data volume, learner compute, generator compute or total search compute is actually matched.
separation: Separate feedback data, candidate-selection data and final test data. Freeze the chosen generator and learner before final evaluation.
cost: Count every generated candidate, rejection, failed trial, repair, selection call and training run. Equal accepted volume does not imply equal generation/search cost.
interpretation: Test the changed update-producing component. The procedure proposing and accepting generator changes may still be fixed.

question: revised_improver
comparison: Start from the same learner and improvement procedure. Compare keeping that procedure fixed with revising it, then evaluate their subsequent learning on separate later tasks or cycles.
keep_fixed: Shared initial agent, update opportunities, data access, task distribution, resource envelope, evaluator and outcome definition. Record any intended difference.
separation: Separate evidence used to construct the revised improver from the later learning stream and its independent tests. Evaluate the subsequent learning effect rather than only the already-selected best artifact.
cost: Include the full cost of constructing/searching the revised improver and all subsequent updates. Retain unsuccessful proposals and rejected branches in the ledger.
interpretation: Tests the changed improvement procedure. None of the87 healthcare studies is coded as demonstrating this level; do not fill a positive healthcare example by inference.
